newsitem.title: USA: Horace Mann comments on storm impact.
newsitem.headline: Horace Mann comments on storm impact.

text.p: Horace Mann Insurance Co, a unit of Horace Mann Educators Corp, said Friday seven percent of its property and casualty business is in North Carolina, which was hit this week by Hurricane Fran.
The Springfield, Illinois-based insurer has about $500 million in annual property and casualty insurance premiums, a spokesman said.

The spokesman said it was too early to assess the company's exposure to hurricane-related claims, but said the North Carolina business was fairly evenly spread rather than concentrated in the most exposed areas.
